verdict.rationale: TaxJar's AutoFile handles state sales tax returns and remittances automatically. Vendor docs say it migrates state reports into returns for on-time filing, ensures deadlines are never missed, and is 'backed by our guarantee'. However, coverage is documented only for US states, and the guarantee's terms, including whether it covers late-filing penalties, are not spelled out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the guarantee covers penalties for late filing, evidence of coverage in every registered jurisdiction (local or non-US) rather than just US states, independent or hands-on corroboration of AutoFile filing on time.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late

citations.quote: AutoFile handles state tax returns and remittances for you, ensuring deadlines are never missed – all backed by our guarantee.
TaxJar electronically migrates your state report to your sales tax return, eliminating manual searches and errors – ensuring accurate, on-time filings.
Ideal for businesses that only need automated filing and remittance in the US
